tool_input.command:
api_key=$SECRET inspect autoapply-clerk-bridge --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | while IFS= read -r env_line; do case "$env_line" in CLOUD_API_KEY=$SECRET printf '%s' "${env_line#CLOUD_API_KEY=$SECRET";; esac; done); if [[ -z "$api_key" ]]; then printf '%s
' 'container API key missing' >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '%s
' 'SYNC_STATUS'; curl -sS -H "X-API-Key: $api_key" http:$REPO_OPPORTUNITIES/sync/status; printf '
%s
' 'FILTER_STATS_HIDE_STALE'; curl -sS -H "X-API-Key: $api_key" 'http:$REPO_OPPORTUNITIES/filter-stats?hide_stale=true&limit=1' | jq '{population_total, filtered_total, hidden_total, livenesses: (.facet_groups[] | select(.key=="livenesses") | .options)}'; printf '
%s
' 'FILTER_STATS_ALL'; curl -sS -H "X-API-Key: $api_key" http:$REPO_OPPORTUNITIES/filter-stats | jq '{population_total, filtered_total, hidden_total, livenesses: (.facet_groups[] | select(.key=="livenesses") | .options)}'
